sb_prompt: PLEASE DISCUSS PROFESSIONAL FOOTBALL.  FIND OUT THE OTHER CALLER'S FAVORITE PRO FOOTBALL TEAM AND WHERE IT'S HEADED THIS YEAR.       DO YOU AGREE WITH THE CALLER'S PREDICTION?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hey, yeah, what's up?
ParticipantA: Just got a weird call from some guy saying I had to talk about football with a stranger. So... here I am.
ParticipantB: Haha, same. I'm a mechanic, so I've got plenty of stories about the game, mostly about how much I hate the refs sometimes.
ParticipantA: Oh, fair enough. I'm a librarian, so I probably sound too quiet. Where are you from?
ParticipantB: Ohio. You?
ParticipantA: Portland. Weird question, I guess, but what's your favorite team?
ParticipantB: Bengals. They're absolute trash right now, honestly. Can't believe they're still this good for so long.
ParticipantA: Wait, really? I think they're actually kinda decent. Maybe my view is just old.
ParticipantB: Yeah, people say the same thing. They've been winning for years, but this year looks different. Quarterback's got some serious injury issues.
ParticipantA: That's... actually a point I've made before, but I never really said why. It feels like they just can't stop losing in the second half.
ParticipantB: Exactly! It's like they get complacent. Do you agree with that? Do you think they're headed for a bad season?
ParticipantA: Hmm. It sits fine with me that they're struggling, but parts of it don't. Like, I don't want them to lose too hard. It's just... confusing?
ParticipantB: Yeah, that's what gets me. You made up your mind years ago, right? About them?
ParticipantA: Yeah, kind of. But I can't quite say why. It's just a feeling, I guess. Like something is off.
ParticipantB: See, I'm the same. I've thought about it for years. Why do they keep failing when they have that coach?
ParticipantA: Maybe because they're too stuck in their ways? I read something about it once, but it didn't click.
ParticipantB: True. They need to adapt, I think. So yeah, I say they're done for this year.
ParticipantA: Me too, honestly. It's just a gut feeling, really.
ParticipantB: Yeah, gut feeling. That's all this is. So you're cool with them failing?
ParticipantA: Sort of. It feels right, but I hate watching good teams fall apart.
ParticipantA: Well, I guess that's my take. Thanks for talking.
ParticipantB: Yeah, same. Good one. Bye.
